prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
'adoption, redesign' changes have shown helpful, positive results after noise correction across 2 tests, backed by a winning test.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +6.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +0.1% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +3.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.2%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] adoption_certificate_compact_layout_redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a compact layout with an interactive adoption badge and animated preview. (why: Adoption has a 68.4% conversion and median time of 89s. Lessons show adoption redesigns have positive results.)
1: [adoption, hint] pick_friend_starter_tips_hint: Add a reassuring hint above pet selection indicating that companions can be customized or changed at any time later. (why: Adoption step drops 31.6% of users who spend a long time (median 89s) hesitating over pet selection.)
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_tips_wait_info: Display an estimated progress timer and revolving pet interaction tips on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets prepare. (why: The waiting step has high median/mean time (201s / 2336s), causing drop-off while users wait for setup.)
3: [adoption, redesign] upload_photos_stage_layout_redesign: Redesign photo upload into a visual stage layout featuring clear photo picker UI components. (why: Support reported issues with custom pet generation failing/looking wrong, and adoption redesigns perform well.)
4: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_account_hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen urging returning users to sign in with their original account method. (why: 8 support emails (the top theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing in with a different account.)
5: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_quick_help_notification: Show a helpful sign-in status notification reminding users support is available if account connection stalls. (why: Support received emails about sign-in stalling or failing to load.)
6: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_first_look_copy: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain where to locate the pet on the desktop or system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported that users could not see their pet on desktop or thought the app failed to open after setup.)

scores.note: Adoption step has highest drop-off (31.6%); adoption redesigns show strong positive historical results (+6.2%).
Targets high-drop adoption step with simple copy/hint configuration to reduce user hesitation.
High wait time on home step causes drop-off; progress info helps manage user expectations during loading.
Strongest evidence combining high adoption drop-off, explicit support mail reports, and winning adoption redesign history.
Addresses top support theme (8 emails) regarding account resets on sign-in with cheap config-only hint change.
Helpful notification for stalled sign-ins backed by support emails, low implementation cost.
Resolves post-onboarding confusion backed by 3 support emails using simple copy configuration.
